limitations: No unsuccessful walking attempt certifies that all walking, jumping or powered routes are unavailable.
Unattempted candidates beyond the walking bound produce no completion notice; the blocked search still stalls at site 5.
Trying all eight armed candidates produces no positive walk. The final site stays requested for other methods until exposure clears.
The full fallback still completes no candidates and starts no powered forecast in this corpus.
Two directed cover-on games change controls and later failed visit structure, but their completed claims and departures stay unchanged.
Two generated worlds and seat swaps are a small correlated sample; notices and repeated publications are not independent physical successes.
Synchronous work remains outside operation quotas; no Pi performance claim.
